items.information:
# ATENÇÃO: Para adentrar a universidade é necessário preencher o formulário abaixo e ler a aba "INFORMAÇÕES"

Link do formulário: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1Liaru_ehdOn113681HxG_JII52ZV2JxyT4bucCGFong/edit

🇧🇷 **Português:**
Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UNESPRioPretoOpen2025/register).
Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, leia o [regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU).
Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, UNESP, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

# ATTENTION: To enter the university you must fill out the form below and read the "INFORMATION" tab

Form link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1Liaru_ehdOn113681HxG_JII52ZV2JxyT4bucCGFong/edit

🇬🇧 **English:**
Your registrarion will only be apporved on the WCA website after the payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UNESPRioPretoOpen2025/register) tab.
If this is your first time competing, read the [WCA Regulation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by watching this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU).
There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, UNESP and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

### Informações

Haverá comida para competidores e espectadores no espaço da competição durante o almoço a preço reduzido. Para facilitar o processo para a organização, no momento da inscrição escreve 'ALMOÇO' e indica o número de pessoas (3 = 1 competidor + 2 espectadores).

### Information

There will be food for attendees at the venue durante lunch at a reduced price. To make it easier for the organization team, when registering for the competition please write 'LUNCH' followed by the number of people attending with you (3 = 1 competitor + 2 spectators).

items.name: Utah Snowball Bash 2025
items.information:
This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahSnowballBash2025#59029-cubing-club-at-uvu).

Club members will receive a 50% registration discount!

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjI5MDksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--43b2c6997b6d11e8b4a77dd03ba583f2175d45ff/compdisplaycubingclubuvu.png)](https://uvu.campusgroups.com/CubingClub/club_signup)
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBblkvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--78136ba2316603f64144b1e4187349c9f12b5dd9/image.png)](https://utahcubing.org)

items.name: Temecula Valley Winter 2025
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TemeculaValleyWinter2025#65365-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com):

items.name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 68 - Belmont 2025
items.information:
This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

- [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! 
- *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
